Class InventoryManagerImpl

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.inventory.impl.InventoryManagerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryManager, org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class InventoryManagerImpl extends Object implements InventoryManager, org.bukkit.event.Listener
Production implementation of InventoryManager with stack-based navigation, a global auto-refresh ticker, and Bukkit event routing.

This class serves as the central coordinator for all GUI inventory operations in KLibrary. It manages:

  • Provider registry — A thread-safe map of registered InventoryProviders
  • Per-player view stacks — Deque-based navigation stacks for each player
  • Active view index — A fast Inventory → InventoryView lookup for efficient event routing
  • Global ticker — A repeating task (every 20 ticks / 1 second) that calls InventoryProvider.update(InventoryView) on all auto-refresh views

Thread Safety

All internal maps use ConcurrentHashMap to support concurrent reads from the ticker thread and writes from event handlers (main thread). However, individual stack operations (push(Player, String, InventoryContext), pop(Player),

invalid reference 
#replace
) should only be called from the main server thread.

Event Handling

This class implements Listener and automatically registers itself for:

  • InventoryClickEvent — Routes clicks to the active provider
  • InventoryOpenEvent — Notifies the provider of open events
  • InventoryCloseEvent — Handles stack cleanup with a 1-tick delay
  • PlayerQuitEvent — Clears all state for disconnecting players

    • push

      public void push(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player, @NotNull @NotNull String providerId, @NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Description copied from interface: InventoryManager
      Pushes a new inventory view onto the player's navigation stack and opens it.

      The view is created by the registered InventoryProvider matching the given provider ID. If no provider is found, this method does nothing.

      Specified by:
      push in interface InventoryManager
      Parameters:
      player - the player to open the inventory for; must not be null
      providerId - the ID of the registered inventory provider; must not be null
      context - the context for this inventory session; must not be null

    • pop

      public void pop(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      Description copied from interface: InventoryManager
      Pops the current inventory view from the player's stack and opens the previous one.

      If the stack becomes empty after popping, the player's inventory is closed. If the stack is already empty, this method does nothing.

      Specified by:
      pop in interface InventoryManager
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose current view should be popped; must not be null

    • getStackSize

      public int getStackSize(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      Description copied from interface: InventoryManager
      Gets the depth of the inventory navigation stack for the player.

      A value of 0 means no managed inventory is open. A value of 1 means one view is open (no back history). Values greater than 1 indicate the player has navigated through multiple menus.

      Specified by:
      getStackSize in interface InventoryManager
      Parameters:
      player - the player to query; must not be null
      Returns:
      the number of views in the player's stack (0 if none)
